posts.title: How I Code Review LLM-generated Code
posts.description: Code review is more important than it used to be, which makes trunk-based development, a good diff viewer, LLM review, and opening code locally crucial

posts.title: It's 2026, and I'm still leery of using LLMs to generate code
posts.description: LLMs are great at generating code, but writing code helps me think and understand the system I'm building.

posts.title: You probably don't need `find`
posts.description: Between zsh's globbing, Bash's `shopt -s globstar`, and `fd`, you probably can avoid ever using `find`.
